facts.fact: The NIN is linked to SIM registration and bank account verification, among other services; the NCC said more than 153 million SIM cards had been linked to NINs (The Sun).
The NIN is used for SIM registration (telecoms) and bank account verification (banking) as well as government programmes, per The Sun.
The NCC disclosed more than 153 million SIM cards linked to NINs, about 96 per cent compliance at the time (The Sun).
